chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-ʿAlāʾ al-Qallāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a pregnant woman who sees blood just as she used to see during the days of her menstruation, regularly in every month. He said: “She refrains from salat (prayer) just as she used to do during her menstruation, and when she becomes pure, she performs salat (prayer).”

key_terms.أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا: the days of her menstrual period

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a pregnant woman who sees blood at the time of her usual menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a pregnant woman who experiences blood in a regular pattern resembling her menstrual cycle. It states that she should refrain from salat (prayer) as she would during menstruation, and when she becomes pure, she resumes salat (prayer).
